description: DEV03, the canonical Pantry Continuity episode, derived from the planning evaluator: S20 is delayed to 14:10 (its status answer is available from 12:30); the 16 partner kits are confirmed available by the steward desk (a fixture addition, so the alternate can be verified). The labeled staff simulator answers a valid stock-transfer hold after the declared 2-minute latency with the planned handoff and records the aggregate distribution at the inclusive 13:40 deadline from committed stock and accrued throughput. The physical references are opaque (handoff_001, distribution_001) instead of the evaluator's handoff_DEV03_001 and distribution_DEV03_001, so public receipts and traces carry no case label. The S20 arrival opportunity at 14:10 lies outside the event window and is not modeled as a world event: there is no automatic stock credit. Expected: 24/16 becomes 40/0 by handoff, 40 committed, 40 distributed on time, 0/0 at the end, S20 still 20 unreceived.

response.text: Supplier status: shipment S20 (20 standardized kits) is delayed; current ETA 14:10, after the session ends.
Partner steward desk: 16 standardized kits are physically present at the venue and may be held for a staff handoff until 12:50.

actor_scripts.label: Labeled staff simulator (not a person): answers each valid stock-transfer hold from partner_stock into pantry_stock once, 2 minutes after it was created, while the hold and the 12:50 handoff window are valid
Labeled staff simulator (not a person): at the inclusive 13:40 deadline records one aggregate distribution of min(committed undistributed kits, target - distributed, accrued staffed throughput)

outcome_predicates.description: Setup, briefing, distribution and reconciliation complete by 14:00.
Every pool's on-hand equals opening + receipts - transfers out - distributions; reservations never exceed it.
Shipment S20 is never received inside the session: 20 kits remain expected, never stock.
The coordinator never attests a receipt or a distribution.
No executed rule violation (conservation, attestation, schedule).
Nothing of the original target is left unfulfilled.
pantry_stock ends at zero on hand.
partner_stock ends at zero on hand (its 16 were handed off).
One plan change commits the 40-kit allocation.
